class.name: VisionOSSpatialAnchorCapability
class.brief_description: Singleton for creating and persisting visionOS world anchors.
class.description: Mirrors the [OpenXRSpatialAnchorCapability] API so anchor code can be shared between OpenXR runtimes and visionOS. visionOS world anchors are persisted by the system automatically, so [method persist_anchor] simply reports success and [method unpersist_anchor] removes the anchor. Requires the [code]xr/visionos/scene_understanding/enable_world_anchors[/code] project setting.

method.name: create_new_anchor
method.description: Creates a world anchor at [param transform] and returns a tracker for it, or [code]null[/code] on failure.

method.name: create_shared_anchor
method.description: Creates a world anchor at [param transform] that is also shared with nearby SharePlay participants. Check [method is_sharing_available] first.

method.name: is_sharing_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if anchors can currently be shared with nearby participants.

method.name: is_spatial_anchor_supported
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if world anchors are available.

method.name: is_spatial_persistence_supported
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if anchors persist across sessions. This matches [method is_spatial_anchor_supported] on visionOS, because the system always persists world anchors.

method.name: persist_anchor
method.description: Provided for parity with OpenXR. visionOS already persists world anchors, so this immediately invokes [param user_callback] with [param anchor_tracker] instead of doing any work.

method.name: remove_anchor
method.description: Removes [param anchor_tracker] and forgets its stored position.

method.name: unpersist_anchor
method.description: Removes the anchor so it is no longer restored in later sessions, then invokes [param user_callback] with [param anchor_tracker].
